name: graded_belief_allocation
summary: Graded belief allocation (100-point bet) across 2-4 objects and 2-4 features on informative and prior trials.

charter.question: When listeners express graded credence across candidate referents on informative and uninformative trials, do their belief distributions reflect recursive pragmatic inference with shared perceptual priors, depth-3 graded lexical precision, competitor-confusion avoidance, or a singleton oddity heuristic?

instructions.welcome: Welcome! In this short study, you will play a communication game where a speaker describes one of the objects on the screen.
instructions.task: On each turn, you will see a row of objects and a word from the speaker. Distribute 100 points across the objects to show how likely each object is to be the one the speaker is talking about. Give more points to objects that are more likely, and 0 points to objects that cannot be the one. Your points must add up to 100. On some turns, the speaker's word is missing; distribute your 100 points based on which object you think the speaker is most likely to talk about.

comprehension_checks.question: How many total points must you distribute across the objects on each turn?
options: As many points as you want

comprehension_checks.question: What should you do if an object cannot be the one the speaker is talking about?
options: Give every object the same points
